[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Hannah was born in 1750. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-2868|James Glasgow]] and [[Hartshorne-320|Ann Hartshorne]]. She passed away in 1816.
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2868]] is assessed at 95% (proved). The held Maryland State Archives probate-family summary names Hannah among James Sr./Ann’s Cecil children. Her local generation fits that particular adult family; the Scottish 1720 James-to-Maryland identity is not established.

Named child to the specific adult family role represented by the selected father; independent earlier ancestry is outside this assessment.

Next useful test: Inspect James Sr.’s 1784 Cecil probate and children’s estate/guardianship papers behind MSA SC 3520-17195.
